title: release review: DD + constraints + DB — data integrity
description:
Correctness review of the persistence and enforcement backbone. Every query the rest of the system makes trusts the DB layer. The DD constraint engine is a complex concurrent system.

## Approach

Read all files below and review for data integrity, concurrency, and SQL correctness. Produce findings in standard YAML schema. Focus on correctness bugs, race conditions, and silent data corruption.

## Files (~5.5k LOC)

src/constraints/engine.rs, src/constraints/worker.rs, src/constraints/resolver.rs, src/constraints/mod.rs, src/db/mod.rs, src/db/graph.rs, src/db/migrations.rs, src/db/components.rs, src/db/conventions.rs, src/db/constraints.rs, src/db/health.rs, src/db/similarity.rs, src/rules.rs

## Mandate

- DD engine: Is the worker thread correctly synchronized? Could a delta update race with a query? Are cycle detection and forbidden-pair queries correct for all graph shapes (including degenerate: single node, self-loop, empty graph)?
- Constraint resolution: Does the resolver correctly map high-level constraint declarations (TOML) to file-pair forbidden lists? Are component-scoped constraints correctly expanded?
- SQL correctness: Scan every query in src/db/ for: missing WHERE clauses, wrong JOIN types, potential SQL injection (string interpolation into queries), missing indexes for frequent query patterns, incorrect ON CONFLICT behavior.
- Migration completeness: Do the migrations create every table/index that the code expects? Are column types consistent with how Rust reads them (especially i64 vs TEXT for IDs)?
- Rules parsing (rules.rs): Is TOML parsing robust? Could malformed constraint files produce silent partial parses instead of errors?
- DB abstraction: Are there places where a caller can observe inconsistent state because operations that should be transactional aren't?
execution_record:
Review complete. 12 findings (2 high, 5 medium, 5 low, 0 critical). Written to docs/reviews/2026-06-05-dd-db-integrity-review.md.

High: Two DELETE + bulk INSERT patterns without transactions (replace_health_findings, replace_hrr_vectors) — crash mid-loop loses data.

Medium: blast_counts inspect callback order-dependent in DD worker; reload() silently discards forbidden_pairs; no_cycles scope parsed but never enforced; delete_file_cascade not transactional; create_waiver returns wrong ID on upsert path.

Low: .ok() swallows DB errors in get_convention_state; codebook entries return value wrong; health_score INTEGER/f64 mismatch; snapshot bulk inserts no txn; recursive DFS stack depth.

Clean categories: SQL injection (all parameterized), WHERE clauses, JOIN types, ON CONFLICT, migration completeness, DD thread sync, DD state machine, TOML parsing, constraint identity hashing.
